subject: Architecture
title: Versailles: Architecture as Power
description: Learn Versailles: Architecture as Power in one minute.

hook.text: Louis XIV moved France's government to a palace so large it housed 10,000 people.

buildup.text: The Hall of Mirrors stretches 240 feet with 357 mirrors reflecting candlelight and gardens.

discovery.text: Louis forced nobles to live at Versailles so he could watch them and prevent rebellion.

twist.text: Despite its grandeur, the palace had no proper bathrooms. Courtiers used hallway corners.

climax.text: The palace cost so much it helped bankrupt France — fueling the revolution that ended the monarchy.

punchline.text: He built a palace to project power. It destroyed his dynasty.

quiz.question: Why did Louis XIV force nobles to live at Versailles?
options: To share the palace's luxury with them
To keep them under his watch and prevent rebellion
To collect taxes from them more efficiently
